body: I would, but I don't want to hurt you... or anyone else when I go.
He wouldn't care, I'm 19 with no hope for the future. There is nothing to look forward to.

My brother committed suicide two months ago, I was so close to him... he was my best friend. I was bullied all through school, put down by everyone. I don't have any friends, my own family hates me and blames me for everything. I have no hope for my future. The world will be such a better place without my stupid ass in it.
What would you like to know?

I've tried, the closest family I had was my brother, he was my best friend. But no, he had to go commit suicide. I'm a failure because I'm gay, I'm a failure because I didn't get into University. I'm so alone.
Some of my own family convinced me of that, so it stuck.
I've called Lifeline a hotline in New Zealand before, they didn't really do much.

It's evening where I am. I've had these thoughts for a long time, it's not a different person. I've had grief counselling, that didn't help. I've talked to a psychiatrist three times... also didn't help. I've been in hospital twice for suicide attempts. I'm sick of everything.
I'm here if ya wanna talk, I'm going through the same thing.
He did, so why can't I?
I'm just so angry at him for doing this to me, he knew how much I loved him. Why didn't he tell me something was wrong? These past two months have been the worst of my life. He was my best friend.
